coverage_note: Countries use Natural Earth 1:50m cultural vector boundaries. Admin-1 uses Natural Earth 1:10m subdivisions (Douglas-Peucker simplified to ~0.005 degrees, i.e. sub-kilometre fidelity, when built with --admin1-simplify), and contains every subdivision Natural Earth publishes. Admin-1 resolution supports country-qualified names/codes and unique bare names; US states also have postal aliases. These are cartographic boundaries, not legal or survey boundaries.
